question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Dodge
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"dodge"** means to avoid something or someone by a sudden quick movement. (बचना)
 
 
• **Example: **He managed to dodge the oncoming traffic just in time.
 
 
 
• **"Avoid" **means to keep away from or stop oneself from doing something. (बचाना)
 
 
• **Example: **She took a different route to avoid the heavy traffic.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'dodge'** is **'avoid'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Force **(बल): Strength or energy as an attribute of physical action or movement.
 
 
• **Example:** The force of the wind knocked down the trees.
 
 
 
• **Boarding **(बोर्डिंग): The action of getting on or into a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle.
 
 
• **Example: **Boarding will begin at 6:30 PM for all passengers.
 
 
 
• **Amount** (मात्रा): A quantity of something, typically the total of a thing or things in number, size, value, or extent.
 
 
• **Example:** The amount of rainfall this year has been significantly higher than last year.
